params.title: Sign-in failure
params.initial_input: CLI="${CMUX_BUNDLED_CLI_PATH:-$(command -v cmux)}"; APP="${CLI%%.app/*}.app"; printf "app=%s\n" "$APP"; open -a "$APP" "cmux-dev://auth-callback?cmux_auth_state=tour-from-an-earlier-launch&stack_refresh=tour&stack_access=tour"; printf "Delivered a sign-in callback this launch never started\n"; "$CLI" settings open account
